title: Add, size, delete
hints: One dict from file name to size covers this stage: `dict[str, int]`.
Check `name in self.files` before writing so a duplicate add can't overwrite the original size.
`dict.pop(name, None)` removes and returns in one step, returning None when the key is missing — exactly `delete_file`'s contract.
Size `0` is real data. Use `is None` checks, never truthiness, when deciding whether a file exists.
